purpose: Pre-transformation baseline per REPORTX P0 mandate Section 4. Real, current-production output only -- no fabricated or hypothetical examples. Dimensions with no structured representation in current output are marked not_measured rather than assigned an invented score, consistent with the mandate's own zero-fabrication rule applied to this baseline's own methodology.

pipeline_a_python_blogger.method: python -m automation.main --dry-run --max-posts 20, against real live sources, plus 3 full-HTML captures via direct AuthorityTransformer.transform() calls on real freshly-discovered NVD CVEs

dry_run_category_breakdown.note: categories present in real current feeds at time of sampling; phishing/zero-day/breach/strategic-general were not present in this specific sample window -- not fabricated to fill the mandate's target category list

llm_authorship.provider_failures: all 4 providers (groq, deepseek, openrouter, anthropic) returned no_api_key in this environment
llm_authorship.structural_consequence: analytical_depth_gate.py requires content_source in {groq,deepseek,openrouter,anthropic} for PREMIUM_LONG_FORM eligibility -- 100% of sample capped at TACTICAL_READY or below regardless of evidence completeness

commercial_readiness_scorecard.actual_publish_behavior: all 20 items marked 'would publish' regardless of publication_eligible value -- confirms the scorecard is observability-only, not a gate, for any threshold above PUBLIC_REFERENCE_DRAFT
commercial_readiness_scorecard.finding: high aggregate score (92-96/100) co-occurring with low section coverage (55-60%) on every single sample -- matches the mandate's own Section 21 concern that a high aggregate score can mask real gaps. Not yet determined whether coverage is under-weighted in the scoring formula or whether 55-60% coverage is itself an accurate reflection of what this pipeline can currently populate -- flagged for the implementation phase, not resolved here.

integrity_gate_result.note: zero PublicationIntegrityError raised across the sample -- the fail-closed evidence gate is real but nothing in current real-world input is currently tripping it

full_html_samples.source: real NVD CVE records, fetched live

claim_level_traceability.reason: no claim_id/claim_text/evidence_refs/status data model exists in current output -- the report is prose + a fixed Provenance table, not a claim graph. Nothing to count.

key_judgements.reason: no Key Judgements section exists in current renderer output; report_contract.py's SECTION_3_KEY_JUDGEMENTS resolves to WITHHELD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for every article today (no implementation anywhere in the pipeline, confirmed via report_contract.py's own _IMPLEMENTED_TODAY mapping).

intelligence_gaps_as_structured_data.reason: gaps are implied by prose hedging (e.g. 'exploitation not confirmed by available evidence') but not emitted as a discrete, structured intelligence_gaps[] list anywhere.

forecasts.reason: no forecasting capability exists in Pipeline A's renderer at all.

role_based_decisions.note: report_renderer.py renders role-relevant P0/P1 action bullets per family (e.g. Exposure and Remediation Decisions for CVE family) but not as a named-role/decision/priority/evidence-basis/escalation-condition structured object per mandate Section 15's model.

executive_and_operational_usefulness.reason: subjective dimensions requiring human or LLM-judge evaluation against a rubric -- no rubric exists yet and inventing a score here would itself violate the no-fabrication principle this baseline is trying to model.

pipeline_b_node_vercel.method: static analysis of fetch-live-intel.js and its full require() graph, plus grep-based counts across the real posts/ corpus (4210 files)

section_presence_counts.note: counts reflect posts generated since each feature existed in the generator, not a fixed contract applied uniformly -- posts are written once and never re-rendered

disclaimer_text_consistency.finding: the current .intel-sig signature block text exists in only 63/4210 posts; the remaining ~4147 carry one of several historical generator-version variants (v3.0, v4.0, category-specific taglines). This is a larger-scope version of the historical-disclaimer-consistency issue already identified and partially addressed on the Blogger side.

publication_gate.finding: qualityGate() has no equivalent to Pipeline A's validate_publication() -- confirmed via full-file review, not merely a grep for absence.

llm_authorship.note: reasoning-engine.js explicitly documents itself as model-free ('no model calls, no fabrication') -- this is an intentional architecture choice, not a degraded/broken state like Pipeline A's LLM chain.

orphaned_computation.enrichment_pipeline_attribution_confiden: computed every cycle, persisted to api/intel/threat-graph.json, never read by any HTML or public-API output path
orphaned_computation.api_tier_gating_subsystem: fully implemented (filterForFree/filterForPro/filterForEnterprise/applyTierGating), zero callers anywhere in the repository outside its own test file

att&ck_mapping.higher_quality_system: engine-node/detection-engine.js::mapTechniques() -- confidence-labeled, evidence-quoted, validated against a curated 34-technique registry
att&ck_mapping.lower_quality_system: fetch-live-intel.js::getMitre() -- single-technique regex classifier, no confidence, no evidence

quantitative_scoring_visibility.finding: richer explainability data exists and is computed but only reaches the JSON API feeds, never the blog post a reader actually sees.

governance_engine_reachability.verification_method: exhaustive require()/import grep across both full dependency trees, independently re-verified 3 times across this session by 2 different investigation passes
